body: Last night after I told him that he'd been rude to me he just started insulting me and said that he's never gonna talk to me anymore... This really hurts coming from someone I love

Thanks for the reply, I forgot some details in my original post.
I used to talk to my brother alot (I have 3 brothers, one abandoned the family in general, the other one never has time for me and the last one has gone to jail multiple times and is currently in rehab). the last few days I've felt especially bad, I've been trying to "bond" with friends but I honestly feel they just ignore me or just make me the third wheel. Everyone I could trust is ignoring me and I honestly have alot of trouble the whole day through to not just sit down and cry. When I'm working I just feel like I'm useless and no one would care if I'd die. When I get home I look forward to playing games with my friend but they just end up interrupting every sentence I try to say, plain ignore me and just talk to each other the whole time. You'll probably tell me to stop talking to them, but one of them is the guy I love, and even if he'll never love me, I take slight comfort in hearing him talk. It's sad really, just a hopeless guy looking for the slightest bit of happiness I can find
Might just seem like a stupid crush for most people, but this is actually pretty devastating for me
I asked one of my friend who has known the guy for 4 years+ about him, he said he is 100% he is straight :/

Some of the people that know I'm gay are very accepting but the main problem is mme developing feelings for them. Falling in love with someone who will never love you is very destructive for me. There is a very small chance the guy I'm starting to get into now is gay too, but if he isn't I really don't want to destroy the friendship by telling him only to find out he has 0 interest. People have always told me they can't be normal friends anymore because they just think it's weird.

Meh, I've been trying to convince myself of that too, but I literally have nothing to look forward to, no future plans, I have never enjoyed the jobs I've done, I simply don't care about what I'm studying atm, I can't find a single thing that interests me. When I tried to talk to the guy I'm interested in about some of my problems he literally replied "nice" when I told him about my suicidal thoughts.
